Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

bribery noun

also bribe, bribes, bribed, influenced by bribery, corruption

classical

Cic. Off. 2.52 (Lewis & Short)

largītiō, largītiōnis f.

noun, third declension

bribery, handing out gifts to win support

Other words

  • ambitus, ambitūs m. — electoral bribery

    noun, fourth declension · also used · classical · Lewis & Short; Traupman 283

    The crime of buying votes, tried under the lēgēs dē ambitū.

  • corruptēla, corruptēlae f. — corruption, bribery

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Lewis & Short; Traupman 283

  • corrumpō, corrumpere, corrūpī, corruptum — bribe, corrupt

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Lewis & Short; Traupman 283

    Often with pecūniā or dōnīs; corruptus is “bribed”.

  • pretium, pretiī n. — a bribe, a price paid

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Traupman 283

See also ambition.
